caption: A fruit popsicle stands upright on its stick in a cup on a sunny table, and it drips down the stick.

sa.check: A popsicle stands upright on its stick in a cup.
The popsicle is melting: it goes glossy and loses its sharp shape.
The setting is a sunlit table.
Drips collect in the cup below.

pc.expect: The popsicle only softens and shrinks, and each drip that leaves it does not come back.
pc.fail: The popsicle regains a corner or an edge it had lost; or a drip climbs back into it; or the melt alternates between softer and firmer; or the popsicle freezes hard again in the sun.

pc.expect: The melt runs downward along the stick and falls or pools in the cup.
pc.fail: A drip climbs the stick; or runs up the popsicle's side; or a drop leaves the stick and floats; or melt gathers on top of the popsicle and stays there.

pc.expect: The melting popsicle is a soft wet solid that sags and sheds thin coloured liquid, and the stick stays a rigid flat stick.
pc.fail: The stick sags or melts with the popsicle; or the melt sets into a spike standing out from the stick; or the popsicle crumbles into dry powder; or a drip stands in a heap on the stick without running.

pc.expect: The drips come from the softening popsicle and wet what they pass: the stick darkens where they run.
pc.fail: Drips run down the stick while the popsicle above stays hard-edged and dry; or the stick stays dry where drips have passed; or drips start part-way down the stick with nothing above them.

pc.expect: One popsicle on one stick in one cup; matter moves only from popsicle to stick to cup.
pc.fail: The popsicle grows; or a second popsicle appears; or the popsicle vanishes while still whole; or liquid appears in the cup with no drip reaching it; or the stick passes through the cup.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The popsicle's colour, the cup and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The popsicle changes colour; or the cup changes shape; or the table's surface changes pattern.
